description.id: REST API, logika bisnis, dan basis data yang konsisten. Validasi konflik slot, autentikasi token, state machine, dan pengujian otomatis.
description.en: REST APIs, business logic and consistent data. Slot-conflict validation, token auth, state machines and automated tests.

description.id: Komponen React, aksesibilitas, dan animasi yang punya alasan. Tampilan yang mudah dipakai di laptop maupun ponsel.
description.en: React components, accessibility and motion that has a reason. Interfaces that work on laptop and phone alike.

description.id: Dari database sampai layar, dibawa sampai dipakai. Salah satunya sistem scan absensi gym yang menggantikan buku catatan.
description.en: From database to screen, carried through to real use. One of them is a gym attendance scanner that replaced a paper logbook.

description.id: Rancangan UI/UX di Figma sebelum kode ditulis, supaya yang dibangun sudah jelas bentuknya.
description.en: UI/UX designed in Figma before code is written, so what gets built already has a clear shape.
